content.title: About
content.content: Soy liquid coffee creamer is a plant‑based milk alternative made from soy protein, water and vegetable oils. It gives coffee a creamy texture and a mild nutty flavor, contains no lactose and is suitable for vegans.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Soy creamer is widely used in cafés and restaurants as a dairy‑free alternative.
The added vegetable oils allow the product to stay shelf‑stable before opening.
Soy protein is a complete protein, containing all essential amino acids.
Unlike nut‑based creamers, soy has a neutral taste that blends well with most coffee profiles.
In the United States soy creamer is recognized as safe by the FDA.

items.title: Rich in plant protein
items.content: One serving provides about 3–4 g of protein, helping to support muscle maintenance.

items.title: Low in sugar
items.content: Unsweetened versions are suitable for people monitoring blood glucose.

items.title: Source of vitamin B12 (fortified)
items.content: Some brands add vitamin B12, an essential nutrient for vegans.

items.title: Lactose‑free
items.content: Ideal for individuals with lactose intolerance.

items.title: Contains healthy fats
items.content: Vegetable oils provide mono‑ and poly‑unsaturated fatty acids beneficial for heart health.

items.title: Soy allergy
items.content: People allergic to soy may experience reactions ranging from mild to anaphylaxis.

items.title: Additive content
items.content: Some formulations contain emulsifiers and stabilizers that can cause discomfort in sensitive individuals.

items.title: Genetically modified organisms (GMOs)
items.content: Soybeans are often GMO; choose products labeled “non‑GMO” if this matters to you.

items.title: High sodium levels
items.content: Certain creamers are salted for flavor; those with hypertension should check the sodium content.

content.title: How to Use
content.content: Add 1–2 tablespoons of creamer to hot coffee, latte or cappuccino. It can also be used in cold drinks, smoothies, oatmeal and baking as a milk substitute.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store the unopened container in a cool, dry place away from direct light. After opening, keep refrigerated and use within 7–10 days. Discard if the product develops an off‑smell or taste.
